description: Unit tests for the ApiVersion class in the Notes Android project, verifying API version comparison, equality, and feature support based on API versions.

classes.name: ApiVersionTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ApiVersion class, focusing on comparing major versions, equality, and feature support changes across different API versions.

methods.name: shouldOnlyCompareMajorApiVersions
methods.description: Test that comparison only considers the major API version component.

methods.name: shouldOnlyEqualMajorApiVersions
methods.description: Test that equality checks consider only the major API version.

methods.name: shouldSupportFileSuffixChangesWithApi1_3andAbove
methods.description: Test that support for file suffix changes starts from API version 1.3.

methods.name: shouldSupportNotesPathChangesWithApi1_2andAbove
methods.description: Test that support for notes path changes starts from API version 1.2.
